claims.statement: setup_logging() installs a single StreamHandler on the root logger that emits one JSON object per record to stdout via _JsonFormatter, including ts, level, logger, msg, request_id, trace_id, exc, and extra fields. uvicorn.access and httpx loggers are suppressed to WARNING.
The structured logger never records secrets (API keys, tokens), PII (candidate names, phone numbers), or message content (candidate or bot text). Only request size and safe event metadata are logged.

request_id_middleware stamps every HTTP request with X-Request-Id (from header or uuid.uuid4().hex), sets request_id_ctx context var, echoes it back as X-Request-Id response header, and resets in finally.

trace_id_ctx is the logical turn trace: the webhook stamps request_id into the RQ job dict as trace_id; the worker re-stashes it in trace_id_ctx so the same id flows through RQ → LangGraph → Zalo send logs and onto BotRun.trace_id.

GET /health returns {status: ok, env: app_env}. GET /metrics returns RQ queue depths + worker count + reconcile canary counters. GET /health/queue returns queue depth, LLM latency, 429 count, worker saturation via collect_queue_health(). All are unauthenticated.

GET /admin/performance (admin-only) aggregates BotRun.stage_timings into p50/p95/p99 per stage via five concurrent AsyncSession reads, cached 30s in Redis. GET /admin/performance/slos returns 7 named SLOs with target + actual p50/p95 + green/amber/red status.

DecisionTraceBuilder is bounded by MAX_DECISION_TRACE_EVENTS=64, MAX_DECISION_TRACE_BYTES=128KiB, MAX_MODEL_REASONING_CHARS=16KiB per event. Retention tick clears decision_trace to NULL daily (default 86400s), batch size 200, 30-day retention.

unhandled_exception_handler catches every unhandled exception, logs with request_id via logger.exception, and returns Vietnamese 500 ('Đã có lỗi xảy ra, vui lòng thử lại sau.') instead of bare English error.
